title: F3 follow-up: rebind persistent effects to campaign-actor identity at combat close
description: closeCombatInstance now applies the fail-closed F3 boundary (docs/audits/2026-07-12-f3-mutation-lifecycle-audit.md §7): combatant-owned concentration breaks (owner-removed), combatant targets/condition links are removed (combat-ended), and actor links are released. Effects that should mechanically persist across encounters — persistent familiars/steeds (S1 persistent-link profiles), long-duration summon control (Animate Dead 24h windows) — need promotion/rebinding of their combatant references to stable campaign_actor identity instead, so ownership and control windows survive closure. Requires: a campaign-actor participant kind (or ref rebinding) for active_effect owner/target/link columns, reachability predicates for actors, updateCombatant-equivalent mutation seam for out-of-combat actors, and re-materialization when a new instance starts. Coordinate with S1 runtime rollout (eshyra-o9bd.18.7.9) — do not duplicate its per-spell projection work.
